message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to finding a short‑running movie (≤ 2 hrs) that’s within walking distance of Times Square:

| Theater | Approx. distance from Times Square | Typical movie runtimes | How to check current showings |
|---------|------------------------------------|------------------------|------------------------------|
| **AMC 34th Street – 8** | ~0.3 mi (≈ 5‑min walk) | 90–120 min | AMC’s website or app; search “AMC 34th Street – 8” |
| **Regal Union Square** | ~0.4 mi (≈ 7‑min walk) | 90–120 min | Regal’s site/app; filter by “Running time” |
| **Alamo Drafthouse Cinema – Brooklyn** | ~1.2 mi (≈ 20‑min walk or 5‑min subway) | 90–120 min | Alamo Drafthouse site; look at “Showtimes” |
| **Theater 18 (Cinemark)** | ~0.5 mi (≈ 10‑min walk) | 90–120 min | Cinemark’s site/app; use “Showtimes” |
| **Theater 18 (AMC)** | ~0.5 mi (≈ 10‑min walk) | 90–120 min | AMC’s site/app; filter by “Running time” |

### How to pick a film that fits the 2‑hour limit

1. **Use the theater’s own site or a ticket‑booking platform**  
   - On AMC, Cinemark, Regal, or Alamo Drafthouse, you can usually filter by *“Running time”* or *“Duration”*.  
   - Look for movies listed as “90‑120 min” or “1h 30m” etc.

2. **Check the film’s runtime on IMDb or the official movie page**  
   - If the theater’s filter isn’t precise, quickly glance at the film’s IMDb page (runtime is shown in the “Details” section).

3. **Avoid blockbusters or epic dramas**  
   - These often run 2 hrs 30 min or longer.  
   - Look for comedies, thrillers, or indie films—most of those stay under 2 hrs.

4. **Confirm the showtime**  
   - Some theaters have “late‑night” or “early‑morning” showings that might be shorter.  
   - Double‑check the start time to make sure you’re not missing a 2‑hr cut‑down version.

### Quick example

- **AMC 34th Street – 8**  
  - Search “AMC 34th Street – 8” → “Showtimes” → filter “Running time” → pick a 1 h 45 min comedy.  
  - Walk 5 minutes from Times Square to the theater.

### Tips for a smooth outing

| Tip | Why it helps |
|-----|--------------|
| **Buy tickets in advance** | Saves time and guarantees a seat. |
| **Arrive 15 min early** | Gives you time to grab snacks and settle in. |
| **Check the theater’s Wi‑Fi** | Some venues offer free Wi‑Fi; you can stream the movie on a mobile device if you prefer. |
| **Use a map app** | Confirm the walking route and distance before heading out. |

---

#### Quick links

- **AMC 34th Street – 8**: [AMC.com](https://www.amctheatres.com/movies-and-screens/nyc/amc-34th-street-8)
- **Regal Union Square**: [Regal.com](https://www.regmovies.com/theaters/regal-union-square)
- **Alamo Drafthouse Brooklyn**: [AlamoDrafthouse.com](https://www.alamodrafthouse.com/brooklyn)
- **Cinemark Theater 18**: [Cinemark.com](https://www.cinemark.com/movies/theater-18)

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a specific film recommendation or help with booking!
